terra.problem: The fruit basket breaks the food rule.
Saul’s identification as king of Israel needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage doesn’t say David’s family were at home when they heard about him.
The explanation simply repeats the facts and ends generically, missing a clear opportunity for Papa Dorin’s humor about the crowd.
The passage says about four hundred men, not exactly four hundred.
The passage doesn’t say David did no arguing or rule out three days of packing.
David is said to leave, but the passage doesn’t say he packs up.
The passage in Gath doesn’t say David acted insane in order to get out.
The imagined room conflicts with the setting: Saul was under a tamarisk tree, not in a room.
Saul’s being upset is an unmarked guess about his feelings.
Saul says David is lying in wait, but the explanation states Saul’s belief as a fact rather than identifying it as his accusation.
Saul had a spear earlier, but the passage doesn’t say he is still sitting and holding it when Ahimelech speaks.
Ahimelech says he knew nothing, not that his whole house knew nothing.
Saying Saul doesn’t spare anyone overstates what happens. Abiathar escapes.
